shadow:
Someone has to be on top. That belief sits so far down in us it feels less like a belief and more like weather. It came from a long time ago, when a herd that scattered got eaten and a herd that closed ranks behind a strong one survived. The animal logic still runs. To go up, you press someone down. To feel safe, you hold a thing and call it yours.

Most people read this as the way the world simply is, and so they play their square of the board and never ask who drew the board. That is the misread. Dominance is not the order of things. It is fear wearing a crown. Underneath the climbing and the holding is a small cold question that started in childhood, the day the world stopped feeling safe. Am I going to have enough.

The way out is not a better position on the ladder. It is noticing the fear is yours and not the room's, and letting it have space inside you instead of acting it outward. Hierarchy is fear that has not yet been felt all the way through. Feel it, and the climbing slows. The grip is already starting to ease.
repressive: Some meet the fear by lowering their head. They go quiet near anyone above them, decide that pushing back never ends well, and call the smallness peace. Their own spirit gets handed up the chain without a fight.
reactive: Others meet it by climbing hard. They want the higher rung, the say-so, the room going still when they speak, and they keep the people under them small on purpose. It looks like strength. It is the same fear, aimed outward.
gift:
Something shifts when a person stops needing to be above or below. The fear gets felt instead of acted on, and trust comes up where the grasping was. From trust, a different way of being together becomes possible.

This is synergy. Picture iron filings on paper and a magnet moved underneath. The filings swing into a clean pattern, and the field doing it stays invisible. A group works the same way. Given time and a little room, it finds its own order, and nobody had to stand over it making the order happen. The Gift knows this. It does not run the group. It tends the conditions and waits, and waits longer than feels comfortable, which is the hard part.

It also knows that when a group snags, the snag is rarely one bad person. One person is usually just carrying the whole group's fear out loud. Work through that and the wave moves on. Synergy is that wave. It runs through people the way it runs through the chemistry of a single cell, fusing parts into something that can do what no part could alone. That is also what genius is.
siddhi:
Go far enough and the separateness just thins out. There is no longer a self holding its corner against the others. There is one body, and it is fed by all the bloodlines that ever ran into it, and you are inside it the way a wave is inside water.

This is communion. Think of an early Sunday morning, the hush over the land, even the birds seeming to know. We made Sundays up, the week is not a real rhythm, and still that hush points at something true. A world where the pause is the ground and the work is the small thing. Money loses its job here. Money was only ever fear keeping score, a way of giving with a condition attached. Give without the condition and the scorekeeping has nothing to count.

Look back from here and the old House of Dominoes is not a sin to outgrow. It was the blueprint folded small. The hierarchy was the pattern before it learned it was a pattern. The filings were always going to swing into harmony. They were only waiting for the field.
